text:
carla.marketing: Hey team, short & urgent ask for the launch doc + webinar demo. We need a tiny reproducible bench to justify the headline latency/cost numbers for two configs: model-13B-4q and model-70B-fp16. Metrics: p50, p95 (warmed and coldstart), tokens/sec, and a GPU-cost breakdown (V100 vs A100). Also want trace-level headers so Sales can route leads. Target: 120 requests per config, deadline ~18h.

troy.runtime: Ok. We'll run 120 requests each, warmup=12, seq_len=512, batch=auto. Do you want the 13B quant as 4-bit or 8-bit?

carla.marketing: Use 13B-4q (4-bit). Include separate coldstart runs. Important: add a stable header `X-RW-UTM:launch-1` to tagged requests and include a `bench_id` in traces for joins.

ishaan.eng: I'll schedule on a small staging pool. Plan: run both configs, then a mixed demo (50/50 tagged) at concurrency=5 to validate header propagation. ETA ~5h. Will produce: metrics CSV, latency hist, tokens/sec, bench_map.csv, sample_traces.tar.gz, cost_breakdown.txt.

zoe.analytics: For CRM joins, we need bench_map.csv with columns: bench_id, model, header_tag, run_ts, commit. Also include a small sample of traces (5 per run) with headers visible.

benchbot: Job queued: bench-2834567890 (owner: ishaan.eng). Est runtime: 00:22:00.

ishaan.eng: 13B-4q pass complete. Warmed p50=45ms p95=200ms; coldstart p95=470ms. Throughput ~760 toks/sec. Uploaded: s3://redwood-dev/launch-bench/2834567890/13b-4q/.

ishaan.eng: 70B-fp16 pass complete. Warmed p50=118ms p95=420ms; coldstart p95=940ms. Throughput ~2150 toks/sec. Uploaded: s3://redwood-dev/launch-bench/2834567890/70b-fp16/.

ishaan.eng: cost breakdown (gpu pricing + token calc) saved as cost_breakdown.txt in each out dir. Runtime: v2.4.0, commit: a1b2c3d. Command used: ./tools/calc_cost --tokens N --gpu-price <price> --batching auto.

maria.sales: Quick ops note: route any hits with X-RW-UTM:launch-1 to the launch nurture queue. If response < 90s mark as hot.

carla.marketing: Can you run a 240-request mixed demo (50% header) at concurrency=5 to demo routing? Need to show routing is reliable under small concurrency.

ishaan.eng: Mixed run scheduled. benchbot: Job started bench-2834567890-mix ETA 00:30:00.

benchbot: Job completed: bench-2834567890-mix.

ishaan.eng: Mixed run finished. Verified header `X-RW-UTM:launch-1` present on tagged requests, bench_map.csv updated. No sampling loss at concurrency=5. Uploaded mixed artifacts: s3://redwood-dev/launch-bench/2834567890/mixed/.

zoe.analytics: Received bench_map.csv and sample traces. Headers and bench_id present. We'll prep a tiny join script to handoff to Sales.

carla.marketing: Please paste the final S3 paths and one-line summary for the slide (model: warmed p50/p95; cost est per 1k tokens and GPU-type note).

ishaan.eng: S3 paths above. Summary lines: 13B-4q (warmed) p50=45ms p95=200ms cost≈$0.11/1k tokens (V100 est); 70B-fp16 (warmed) p50=118ms p95=420ms cost≈$0.48/1k tokens (A100 est). All runs include bench_id and X-RW-UTM:launch-1 where requested. Runtime and commit included in each out-dir.

carla.marketing: Perfect. I'll draft the slide and tag you for quick review. If anything changes in the next 12h ping here. Thanks! :sparkles:
